title: TS2Python wire v1 — bar_1m
description: Payload emitted by EL_PublishTickEx: an already-formed 1-minute OHLC bar. Frame 2 of a 2-frame ZMQ message; frame 1 is the UTF-8 symbol topic. See envelope.md and semantics.md — schema validation alone is NOT sufficient to implement a correct binding.

ts.description: DLL receive-side wall clock, UTC epoch seconds. Latency measurement only. Must NOT be used for bucket alignment.

ts_utc.description: ts_str converted to UTC epoch by the DLL. 0.0 on parse failure. Cross-check only.

ts_str.description: Raw EL timestamp, yyyy-MM/dd-HH:mm:ss (24-hour). AUTHORITATIVE source for bucket_start: parse as America/New_York, convert to UTC. bucket_start is LEFT-labelled, covering [t, t+1min). See semantics.md §1 and §2.

vol.description: Bar volume. Double even though semantically integral. Meaningless for index/breadth symbols.

bid.description: Bid at bar close. ALWAYS a number on the wire — never null. Bindings MUST treat this as invalid for the index/breadth symbols listed in semantics.md §3.

ask.description: Ask at bar close. Same caveat as bid.

tc.description: Tick count within the bar. Emitted as %.0f.
